environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no authentication. The service is exposed via ALB target group on port 8080. ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is set to a weak value 'service-admin-2024'. No request signing or IAM authentication is configured. The ALB forwards all HTTP requests directly to the service without any managed rule groups or authentication middleware.

config.network: ALB public-facing, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
config.auth: none - ALB passes all requests through
